description: Combine the 27.3 ms persistent n512 correction pipeline with the proven n1024 pair-lane compact-WY recurrence: transplant only the recurrence and its launch geometry, reconcile shared extension source cleanly, preserve every n512 density policy, certificate, fallback, other size route and CUDA guard, then validate and profile both target sizes for integration effects.

Merged the persistent n512 correction parent with only the n1024 compact-WY factor path from the pair-lane parent. The exact 8/4-warp launch split, aligned cp.async stages, pair-lane alternating recurrence, width-254 fallback, extension binding, and n1024 call site were transplanted; first-parent n512 density policy, certificates, fallbacks, all other routes, and guards remain unchanged. Build and kernelguard pass; validation is 39/39. Full geomean is 27330.087 us versus first-parent replay 27299.360. Dense n512 is 57504.234 us versus 57512.906, mixed n512 102407.382 versus 102033.926, and dense n1024 39008.086 versus pair-parent 38946.496. Mixed-n512 nsys is effectively unchanged: accurate/fast panel kernels 25.146/5.191 ms, global tridiagonal solve 3.724 ms, selective sytrd4 tail 3.417 ms, and six Newton kernels 0.882 ms. Dense-n1024 nsys measures three async factor launches at 0.952 ms plus 0.254 ms fallback, 1.205 ms total versus 1.206 ms in the pair parent.

Exact committed-source replay of the clean two-parent integration after profiling both target sizes. Cached build, kernelguard, and all 39 validations pass. Full geomean is 27305.775 us, reproducing the first parent 27299.360 within 6.4 us and improving the initial combined run 27330.087. Dense/mixed/rankdef/clustered/LAPACK-even n512 are 57497.419/102020.156/95565.473/123033.366/55750.858 us versus parent replay 57512.906/102033.926/95545.759/123045.865/55792.277. Dense n1024 is 38982.751 us versus pair-parent replay 38946.496, with other n1024 shapes unchanged within run noise. Final nsys captures for mixed n512 and dense n1024 are attached to this SHA and reproduce both parent launch graphs.
